title: Python T=0 fragmentation state loss on reboot admits delayed prior-session ACKs
description: Final ACK correctness review: LinkLayer persistence saves replay/trust state but omits active and terminal hold-down SchcSessionManager records. After restart, a new transfer for the same local/remote/rule tuple can start immediately; because T=0 has no DTag, a delayed replay-fresh ACK from the pre-crash transfer can transition the new sender. Persist or conservatively reconstruct active/terminal session tombstones and their high-water/expiry semantics across reboot, failing closed when ambiguous. Test crash during active transfer, delayed old ACK with a fresh link counter, hold-down restoration/expiry, restart corruption, and safe new-session recovery.
